messages.content: Can you provide the address for latitude 37.4224764 and longitude -122.0842499 using the Geocoding API?

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials as an array where the first element is the username and the second is the password.

message.content: Sure! To retrieve the address for those coordinates via the Google Maps Geocoding API, I’ll need your API key so I can make the request. Could you please share your Google Maps Geocoding API key (or let me know if you’d prefer I use a different public geocoding service)?
